summary: Cooked Heartland depth candidate. New companies, visible development, named companion, strategic landmarks and differentiated battlefields. Capped functional proof is not performance qualification.

sections.title: Playable companies and the Kenney interface
sections.note: Actual 1280 x 800 cooked capture. Infantry, archers and Veteran Guard are paid companies with finite stock. Cavalry is not claimed.

figures.caption: Three company roles, named companion assignment and 1/2/3-day construction controls.

sections.title: Three native city development groups
sections.note: The paid progression uses the same settlement authority for authored buildings and campaign miniature. These are role-assigned authored facades, not newly built specialist interiors.

sections.title: Campaign representation
sections.note: Both representations use the same saved building levels. Terrain and canonical anchors remain unchanged.

figures.caption: Upgraded campaign miniature and company roster.

sections.title: Rowan in the authored city
sections.note: City-only embodiment; Rowan does not yet fight or follow the field army.

figures.caption: Owned Knight body, native idle and explicit companion assignment.

sections.title: Strategic landmarks
sections.note: Owned windmill/shrine derivatives and modular quarry works. Gameplay remains the existing site authority. Art is provisional, particularly quarry composition.

figures.caption: Quarry works and the paid-resource interaction.

sections.title: Woodland battle
sections.note: Forest Edge uses actual woodland trees, rocks and ground. Nonphysical procedural-authoring volumes no longer obstruct reinforcements. RBCombat resolves the fight; exact company survivors persist.

figures.caption: Human companies in the forest, with distinct formation cards.

sections.title: River crossing battle
sections.note: Southern Crossing has a measured physical deck, parapets and river walking boundary. Approach waypoints lead troops through the bridge mouth. A natural cooked result and F5/F9 passed; broader pathfinding remains provisional.

figures.caption: Hero and troops at the crossing.
Natural battle result returned to the campaign.

sections.title: Authored city approach and enemy commander
sections.note: The existing Human Capital outer approach remains a field battle. This is not Siege V0.

figures.caption: Actual Human Capital environment; exact Dwarf commander and existing combat authority.

sections.title: Siege feasibility inspection
sections.note: Inspection only. The actual authored gate is not proof of an implemented siege.

figures.caption: Native gate approach used for physical route inspection.

sections.title: Diplomacy V0
sections.note: Cooked UI actions: two real 250-gold gifts, peace, a normal AI day, a non-aggression pact, explicit betrayal, then exact F9 restoration. Human-facing rules only; peace grants no military access.

figures.caption: Initial refusal and itemized acceptance score.
Peace purchased through real gifts and movement costs.
F9 restores pact, treasury, movement and world state.

sections.title: Final build: mixed-company Human defense
sections.note: Human remains the tactical defender against a real Dwarf attack. The isolated fixture redistributes the existing 45 soldiers into 37 infantry, 4 archers and 4 guards. Natural victory returned 28 infantry, 4 archers and 0 guards; F5/F9 and cold restoration passed. This is the city outer approach, not a siege.

figures.caption: Human hero and three exact company roles defending the authored city approach.
Natural result and surviving companies returned to the campaign.
